text: My experience is only around the Parking forum, so my review is based on this specific experience. As someone who needed information on pursuing actions around an unfair parking fine it was pretty good to read, although there are plenty of other very good forums and sites out there too. It’s free so that’s another bonus. But as a normal person, just there looking for information, some discussion as needed and of course a little moral support, I was really shocked by the OTT attitudes and behaviour of some of the regular forum members. Snooty, supercilious, self serving and anti anyone new who’s just finding their way with a specific issue - without the new people who seek info and advice from it, this forum wouldn’t exist would it so why abuse us? I think the administrators need to ‘police’ it better. Just like any forum you come across, it has people there who for them being a regular on it is their life and it comes across that their egos are far more important than the purpose of the forum, which is supposed to be to provide altruistic help to members of the public. I’m afraid I did experience bullying behaviour from ‘regulars’ with repeated attempts to belittle me. There were also some very good people and some good tips but as usual the bad are louder, distract from the reason you’re there and tend to be what you remember.

I don't trust them anymore. And since trust is what their business model is based on I can't see how this company can remain as lucrative a money earner in the long term.  A reputation takes years to build and a day to lose. They should be taking this seriously.  UPDATE: I SENT TWO EMAILS TO ORG600 6 AND 8 DAYS AGO RESPECTIVELY (INCLUDING TO THE EMAIL YOU PROVIDED IN YOUR RESPONSE) AND HAVE HAD NO MORE THAN AN AUTOMATED RESPONSE. DO YOU REALLY CONSIDER THIS GOOD ENOUGH?  DO YOU HAVE ANY DATA WITH REGARDS THE NUMBER OF EMAILS YOU RECEIVE MONTHLY FROM DISGRUNTLED CUSTOMERS ABOUT CASH BACKS AND VOUCHERS THAT NEVER MATERIALISE. AND TO THE PERCENTAGE OF COMPLAINT EMAILS YOU EVEN RESPOND TO. AND THE PERCENTAGE OF SUCCESSFUL OUTCOMES TO CUSTOMERS FOLLOWING COMPLAINT. I WOULD LIKE TO SEE FULL TRANSPARENCY FROM YOU ON THIS IMPORTANT MATTER. (ALTHOUGH I KNOW BETTER THAN TO EXPECT THAT YOU EVEN HAVE SUFFICIENT RECORDS TO ANSWER THE ABOVE, OR WOULD WISH TO SHARE THIS INFORMATION IF YOU DID HAVE THE RECORDS).  Edit on 20 March 2019  This exchange with ORG600 is ludicrous. I am apparently always just one step away from a response, just send your email to this email instead they say. This company promotes other company's services and expects us to trust them enough to spend our hard-earned cash at their recommendation. We are talking here about a company that has revenues in the hundreds of millions of pounds (which they have profited from our trust) and they apparently won't even pay someone to read the emails that concerned customers are sending them. Unless you order a few items at a time which would mean multiple delivery charges. It’s absolutely infuriating when you spend time adding things to your basket and Broussard’s g for it all to be emptied and you have to start all over again. For this reason, I only shop online with ORG411 if it’s a must. With all other shopping apps, I add things to my basket as I remember about them then checkout when I’ve got everything. With this app I have to jot things down and try and blast through and find everything within the allocated time, it’s like a supermarket sweep. Also during checkout, on the upside I had some vouchers through my credit card, to apply and they went through no problem at all, but then it wouldn’t let me checkout for free delivery despite spending about £500, it would only let me “pay” when I tapped on the £3.ORG176 delivery option. It’s little things like this that make this app so user unfriendly. I presume that the reason for the basket emptying is to make people checkout fast, but in my case anyway it totally backfired on ORG411 because,  for 1, it makes it a thought to use the app in the first place,  2, I have to paper and pencil a list and type and shop at a million miles an hour to get everything on one order unless I want to do lots of smaller orders and incur lots delivery charges.  I love ORG411 in the actual shops, very good customer service, but this app is just a headache for me. It’s a real shame.   Everything ORG411 sells is of such high standard and along with the good customer service and very reasonable pricing, it’s just a real, big shame this lets them down so badly.   Sort this ORG411!!

These guys misled me into funding my account. I received no less than three emails informing (and congratulating) me that my account application had been 'approved'. On that basis, I transferred a not insignificant sum. The problems started when I went to make my first trade, but received an error message saying that my residential address was still being verified. Surely, if my account was 'approved', that meant that all checks were complete and my account was ready to use? Apparently not with IB! I would not have funded the account had I not been led to think that everything was good to go.   So, on to the customer support, which is really, really, really, slow and unhelpful. After an hour-long live chat with excruciating waits in between responses, I was told that someone would be contacting me by email soon to help me get it resolved ASAP. I accepted that, but, still annoyed, filed my own complaint ticket as well. 24 hours later, I had received neither an email from an IB representative (aside from another generic one reminding me that my account was now 'approved' and funded!), nor a response to my complaint ticket.   Having lost faith in IB and wanting to take my business elsewhere, I tried to withdraw my funds and close my account, only to be told that I must wait three days before I can do so. Given that I was misled into sending the funds in the first place, I think this is absolutely shocking.   IB may be one of the cheaper brokers, but it is clearly a case of you get what you pay for. Avoid them at all costs.
